spans.s: घोष (I) m. 1. Noise, tumult, स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् Bg.i.19; 2. the thundering of clouds, स्निग्धगंभीरघोषम् Megh.ii.1; 3. a proclamation; 4. the soft sound heard in the articulation of certain letters (in gram.); 5. a herdsman, हैयंगवीनमादाय घोषवृद्धानुपस्थितान् R.i.45; 6. a hamlet, a station of cowherds, गंगायां घोषः K.Pr.ii.; 7. a Kāyastha.
घोषण n. Declaring publicly, speaking aloud, proclamation, दिग्विजृंभितकाकुत्स्थपौलस्त्यजयघोषणः R.xii.72.
घोषणा f. Declaring publicly, speaking aloud, proclamation, दिग्विजृंभितकाकुत्स्थपौलस्त्यजयघोषणः R.xii.72.
घोषयित्नु m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa; 2. the Indian cuckoo; 3. a bard, a herald.
